SQL_DOC.P_SQL: BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KEP_DS WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_PO_COUNT= $LEGACY_PO_COUNT$ AND DS_SEQ = $DS_SEQ$ ) BEGIN INSERT INTO KEP_DS ( PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , LEGACY_PO_COUNT , DS_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , ITEM_QTY , DS_DATE , NOTE , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE , IF_TIME ) VALUES ( $PLANT$ , $LEGACY_PO_NO$ , $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ , $LEGACY_PO_COUNT$ , $DS_SEQ$ , $BUYER_ITEM_NO$ , CAST(ISNULL($ITEM_QTY$,0) AS FLOAT) , $DS_DATE$ , $NOTE$ , 'N' , $IF_DATE$ , $IF_TIME$ ) END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE KEP_DS SET ITEM_QTY= CAST(ISNULL($ITEM_QTY$,0) AS FLOAT) , DS_DATE = $DS_DATE$ , NOTE = $NOTE$ , IF_FLAG = 'N' , IF_DATE = $IF_DATE$ , IF_TIME = $IF_TIME$ WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_PO_COUNT= $LEGACY_PO_COUNT$ AND DS_SEQ = $DS_SEQ$ END END
